script.text: At 56', a penalty kick was awarded in the recorded match: the real timeline runs on and finishes WES 2-1 COP.
Both timelines share every event up to 56', then diverge.
In the alternate timeline the same moment is re-judged: the decision is changed. The simulation plays on from there and finishes WES 1-1 COP.
Turning point at 56': the decision is changed, so the model world finishes WES 1-1 COP against the recorded WES 2-1 COP. Model world: the home win probability finishes at 0% instead of 100%.
